segments.narration: One screenshot. A whole new theme.
NEEF gives your coding agent a clear loop.
Navigate. Make the idea visible. Prototype first, then sharpen the direction with feedback.
Execute. Build the chosen design. Local color extraction, editable colors, and a preview that responds.
Evaluate. Export real CSS. Check the colors and fonts in another interface.
Follow up. Keep improving. Prototype a typography section, compare three font pairings, then bring the chosen version into the app.
